name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-06-08, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
